headlines.headline: FIFTH-YEAR ELIGIBILITY RULING RESHAPES PRESEASON TOP 25 AS TRANSFER WINDOW CLOSES
headlines.detail: Class-wide injunction opened a special Aug. 3-10 transfer window; Arizona, North Carolina, Tennessee and Gonzaga add fifth-year players. Oklahoma lands SMU transfer BJ Edwards; Georgetown adds DePaul's NJ Benson.

headlines.headline: NBA UNVEILS 2026-27 SCHEDULE; WESTBROOK RETIRES, CAVS SHIP SCHRODER TO CHARLOTTE
headlines.detail: Season opens Oct. 20 with Boston at Detroit in an opening-night tripleheader; ABC/NBC air 90 national games. Nine-time All-NBA guard Russell Westbrook retires at 37; Cavaliers trade Dennis Schroder to Charlotte for Tre Mann.

headlines.headline: PRESEASON WEEK 1 CONTINUES FRIDAY; DOLPHINS DEBUT MALIK WILLIS AT QB
headlines.detail: Broncos-Falcons, Dolphins-Commanders and Bucs-Jets kick off 7 PM ET Friday. Miami's Malik Willis makes his debut after replacing Tua Tagovailoa; Denver's Bo Nix sits out entirely.

headlines.headline: FALL CAMPS HEAT UP AS ALABAMA NEARS QB DECISION, OHIO STATE OPENS AS TITLE FAVORITE
headlines.detail: Alabama nears a call between Austin Mack and Keelon Russell; Washington State names its starter by Aug. 24. Ohio State is the national title betting favorite with Julian Sayin and Jeremiah Smith back.
